title: Calculus IV: Vector Calculus (Line Integrals, Surface Integrals, Vector Fields, Greens' Thm, Divergence Thm, Stokes Thm, etc) **Full Course**
description:
This playlist on vector calculus covers approximately six weeks of my Calculus IV course. It follows my full semester multivariable calculus course here: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLHXZ9OQGMqxc_CvEy7xBKRQr6I214QJcd 

The major topics are line integrals, surface integrals, vector fields, conservative fields, Green's theorem, divergence theorem and Stokes' Theorem
